completion_data.completion_summary: Fixed all five verified defects (A-E) across the three task-status scripts and the base implementation agent: admitted partial/blocked as task-level termini, made plan selection version-ordered at all three sites, scoped the idempotency early-exit to state.json only, encoded a fatal-vs-warn decision table for silenced failures, and wired the base agent to own every phase transition via update-phase-status.sh with a Stage 5a self-repair backstop. All six phases verified against isolated fixtures; canonical agent-system/ and gitignored .claude/ mirror trees confirmed byte-identical.

memory_candidates.content: When hardening the three task-status scripts (update-task-status.sh, update-plan-status.sh, update-phase-status.sh), never verify by running them against the real specs/ tree -- they are the machinery that records task status, including for the very task doing the hardening. Build an isolated mktemp fixture per phase: mkdir -p $FIXTURE/.claude/scripts and $FIXTURE/specs/{N}_fixture/plans, cp the scripts in, write a minimal specs/state.json and a plan file with '### Phase N:' headings generated behind `echo` (never as a literal heredoc line, or the scripts under repair will latch onto the fixture-builder's own source text). update-phase-status.sh resolves its own repo_root via SCRIPT_DIR/../.., so it works correctly regardless of cwd; update-plan-status.sh does NOT -- it uses bare relative `specs/...` paths, so it must be invoked with `cd "$FIXTURE" && bash ...` or it silently resolves against the real repo root instead.

Two-tier version-ordered file selection, for picking the 'current' artifact out of a directory that may mix the conforming MM_{short-slug}.md convention with legacy filenames (e.g. implementation-NNN.md): first try `ls DIR/[0-9][0-9]_*.md 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -1`; only if that's empty, fall back to `ls DIR/*.md 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -1`. A plain single-tier `sort | tail -1` across mixed conventions is unsafe -- 'implementation-001.md' sorts after '02_revised.md' because 'i' > '0', silently picking the legacy file. Always guard both `ls` calls with `2>/dev/null` and `|| true` (or `|| echo ""`) under `set -euo pipefail` so an empty directory yields an empty string instead of aborting.
